purpose: Project confirmed floorplan candidates into the generic scene draft

projection.source: Confirmed floorplan image is stored as observed evidence with its SHA-256.
projection.geometry: The materialized candidate plan is projected into the same SceneProgram shape used by text and edit tasks.
projection.assets: Catalog furniture keys become catalogCandidates asset resolutions.
projection.compatibility: The specialized V1/V2/V3 floorplan draft and candidate remain authoritative.

defectFoundAndFixed.cause: Python Pydantic serialized optional values as null while the TypeScript contract accepted only omission.
defectFoundAndFixed.fix: The cross-language contract now treats null and omission as equivalent for optional asset fields.

notClaimed: Generic draft as formal commit source
